title: Paper Boat Harbor - A calm boat-escape puzzle
short: Sail paper boats out of a crowded dawn harbor in the right order. Three new boards every day.
desc:
A dawn harbor is packed with paper boats, and each boat can only sail toward its bow. Tap a boat and it glides out to sea. If another boat or a rock is in the way, it bonks and drifts back. Find the right order and empty the harbor.

· Voyage: harbors grow a little at a time, with longer boats and rocks. Every board is checked to be solvable before you see it.
· Today's Harbor: three new boards each day, the same for everyone on that date.
· Three lanterns: each bump puts one out, and the lanterns you keep become stars.
· Beacon: when you're stuck, it lights up one boat that can sail right now.
· Stamp book: days you clear all three of today's harbors get a stamp. No streak pressure.

A short ad may appear between rounds (at most once every 2.5 minutes). No purchases, no sign-in.

This game was planned and built with the help of AI tools.
